paper_title: ToolFactory Automating Tool Generation by Leveraging LLM to Understand   REST API Documentations
caption: Training loss of APILLAMA. We applied moving average of window size 5 to smooth the training curve. Validation result is produced in every 20 steps.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Training and Evaluation Loss per Batch. The x-axis represents the "Step" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140 with tick marks spaced every 20 steps. The y-axis represents the "Loss" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 2.5 with tick labels at regular intervals of 0.5. The "Smoothed Training Loss per Batch" is depicted as a solid blue line without markers. It begins at a peak value of approximately 2.7 at step 0 and exhibits significant volatility as it generally declines. It drops sharply to roughly 1.4 near step 6, spikes back to about 2.2 near step 10, drops to around 1.0 at step 15, and rises again to roughly 1.6 at step 19. Following a steep decline to roughly 0.6 at step 27, the line continues to fluctuate mainly between 0.1 and 0.5, with a notable brief spike to approximately 0.6 near step 80, before ending at roughly 0.2 near step 132. The "Validation Loss" is shown as a solid orange line without markers, starting at step 20 with a value of approximately 1.6. It demonstrates a distinct downward trend, dropping linearly to roughly 0.5 at step 40. From step 40 onwards, the decline becomes much more gradual, passing through approximately 0.35 at step 60 and 0.33 at step 80, eventually leveling out to end at approximately 0.3 at step 140.
